services.name: Panama Fishing
services.desc: Panama means “place of good fishing”, and whoever named it wasn’t wrong. The Pacific coastline stretching south from the Costa Rica border holds some of the most prolific fishing I’ve found anywhere in the world. Scattered uninhabited islands, pristine reefs, and deep offshore banks that concentrate fish in numbers most anglers never get to see. What makes my Panama trips different is simple: you won’t see another sportfishing boat during your entire stay. I’ve been fishing here long enough to know the water, the fish, and how to put you in the right spot at the right time.
